prompts.sprite:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet for a Mesen 2x HD replacement of the first Holy Diver boss.
Image 1 is the native pose and silhouette reference: six poses left-to-right, stand, step with right knee raised, step with left knee raised, compact crouch/jump, standing mouth-open fire, crouching mouth-open fire. Image 2 is the approved project's crisp sprite style reference only; do not copy the purple character.
Create six polished sprites of exactly the SAME teal-green horned demon in a THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, evenly separated on true transparency. Order: top row stand, right knee raised, left knee raised. Bottom row compact crouch, standing mouth-open fire, crouching mouth-open fire. Full complete bodies no cropping, no labels.
Preserve the unusual original proportions: huge front-facing grimacing head with two ivory curled ram horns framing its sides, heavy brows, short spiky teal hair, dark teal beard, tiny muscular torso and claw hands by the waist, bent green legs and broad clawed feet. No weapon, wings, armor, cape, or extra props. Body about 40 wide by 64 tall native pixels for standing; crouch 40 by 48. Head/torso occupies upper 40 native pixels and stays fixed across poses. The legs alone compact in crouch. Closed mouth stern with small ivory teeth; firing mouth opens wide, black inside with ivory upper fangs. Keep all head sizes and positions consistent.
Style: sharp high-quality Gothic action game sprite art, fine deliberate pixel clusters and crisp edges, readable at 80x128 final pixels, limited teal, deep forest green, dark navy shadows, ivory horns and restrained gold highlights. Detailed sculpted brow, horn texture and muscle shading, never soft or blurry, no motion blur, no glow or ground shadow. Native image's silhouettes and anatomical arrangement take precedence. Camera straight-on side-scroller. Pure transparent background.
prompts.pipe: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single narrow Gothic organ pipe sprite for a 2x HD side-scrolling NES game. Image 1 is the approved environment style reference. Create one complete straight vertical cylindrical brass organ pipe, front view with no perspective, isolated on true transparency. Top has a restrained carved dark-bronze collar and small gothic pointed mouth opening, long unbroken cylindrical shaft in aged reddish bronze with slim warm gold reflection and deep navy shadows, bottom ends cleanly in a slightly tapering dark brass foot. The pipe must be slender, height six times width, top and bottom fully visible with margin. It will be registered to a 32-pixel-wide strip with repeating middle; keep the shaft straight and its lighting vertically constant so middle segments tile. Crisp detailed game texture at small sizes, no bloom, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no extra pipes. Match the detailed dark navy/gold Gothic project reference.
prompts.bell: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: hanging bell game sprite for the Blizzard reward room of Holy Diver HD. First reference is native game screenshot establishing the bell's shape; second is approved Gothic texture style. Create exactly one complete front-facing old cathedral bell suspended from a short iron chain, transparent background. Preserve the native bell's tall flared shape and gently domed top, wide rolled lower lip, vertical ribs, with a small hanging clapper visible below. The chain occupies the top quarter of the full object; bell occupies the lower three quarters. Dark aged bronze with moss green patina, subdued warm gold rim accents, deep navy shadows, finely engraved simple Gothic tracery. No words or writing. It should fit a 96-wide by160-high pixel footprint after registration: readable, crisp high-quality game art, no soft blur. Full chain hook and bell bottom visible. No other objects, no glow or cast shadow, no wall, truly transparent background.
prompts.spell: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: tiny Blizzard spell collectible icon for a Gothic 2x HD game. Make ONE closed upright magical tome, front-facing, transparent background, square silhouette, its dark cobalt cover edged with aged gold clasps, a large clear pale cyan six-point snowflake rune embossed in the center. Thin ivory page edge visible on the right, small red leather binding tab. Must read immediately at only 32x32 pixels after registration, use simple strong pixel-art shapes and crisp high contrast edges with a limited deep navy, cobalt, cyan, ivory and warm gold palette. No letters, no surrounding particles, no halo, no background, no floor or shadow. Entire icon visible with a transparent margin.
prompts.fire: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one enemy fireball projectile sprite for a dark Gothic pixel-art action game. Exactly one ROUND compact ball of fire, full circle silhouette, ivory-yellow incandescent core, golden orange middle, red-orange jagged flame rim, deep burgundy shadow outline. Readable as a filled burning ORB at only 32x32 pixels, crisp deliberate pixel clusters, limited palette, no soft blur. Three small flame tongues can extend around the circumference but keep the silhouette approximately circular and contained in a square. No long trail, no arrow, no second orb, no particles detached from the ball, no text, no background, no cast shadow. True transparent background and generous transparent margin.
